narrationText: Welcome to the VowOS Master Operational Walkthrough. We will start here on the Executive Dashboard, where leadership monitors real-time sales performance and store metrics.
caption: Master Tour — Executive Dashboard

narrationText: Every stat card on the dashboard features one-touch interactive drilldown capabilities. Let us examine Revenue Collected.
caption: Drill Down — Revenue Collected

narrationText: Next, we move to the Brides CRM roster. Here consultants manage active bride profiles, wedding timelines, and fit preferences.
caption: Brides CRM Management

narrationText: Instantly search for brides by name, email, or wedding date to access their comprehensive profile and history.
caption: Search Brides Database

narrationText: This centralized table view provides a rapid overview of all active customers and their progression in the bridal lifecycle.
caption: Active Customers List

narrationText: Clicking Add Bride registers a new customer profile and immediately generates a private, secure digital portal link for them.
caption: Register New Bride Profile

narrationText: In Leads Management, incoming bridal inquiries are tracked from initial web contact through consultation booking.
caption: Leads Pipeline Management

narrationText: The leads table organizes prospects by temperature and engagement level, ensuring no inquiry falls through the cracks.
caption: Evaluate Lead Pipeline

narrationText: Recording a new phone or walk-in inquiry directly into your sales pipeline is instant with the Add Lead function.
caption: Record New Lead Inquiry

narrationText: The Gown Inventory catalog tracks sample dresses, sizes, colors, retail pricing, and store stock levels in real time.
caption: Gown Inventory Catalog

narrationText: Search by SKU, designer name, or specific sizing to instantly locate available sample inventory across all boutique locations.
caption: Search Inventory Catalog

narrationText: Add Gown introduces new designer sample dresses into the global database with full variations for sizing and colorways.
caption: Add New Designer Gown

narrationText: Store Transfers allow seamless inventory sharing between boutique locations for weekend fittings and trunk shows.
caption: Inter-Store Transfers

narrationText: Initiating a gown shipment request to another boutique store takes just a few clicks, ensuring logistical transparency.
caption: Initiate Gown Transfer

narrationText: In Appointments, suite schedules and stylist coverage calendars ensure every bride receives dedicated personal attention.
caption: Appointments & Suite Calendar

narrationText: Toggle seamlessly between daily list views and calendar grids to optimize your spatial awareness of suite bookings.
caption: Toggle Calendar Views

narrationText: Reserving a private fitting suite and assigning a dedicated consultant is streamlined through the booking engine.
caption: Book New Bridal Suite Visit

narrationText: The Time Clock Kiosk enables store staff to clock in, log breaks, and switch store locations securely.
caption: Time Clock & Staff Kiosk

narrationText: Staff can log their shift start instantly, ensuring accurate payroll calculation and compliance with labor regulations.
caption: Clock In For Shift

narrationText: Communications provides a unified SMS and email messaging center for automated appointment reminders and gown updates.
caption: Communications & Messaging Hub

narrationText: Drafting a direct, personalized message to a bride from the unified hub ensures a premium, high-touch communication standard.
caption: Compose New Message

narrationText: Automated sequences dispatch tailored reminders to upcoming appointments, drastically reducing no-show rates and recovering lost revenue.
caption: Run Automation Sequences

narrationText: The built-in AI Magic Reply reads the conversation context and instantly drafts perfectly toned responses to incoming customer queries.
caption: Draft AI Magic Reply

narrationText: Contracts allows brides to review digital purchase agreements and complete electronic signature sign-offs natively within VowOS.
caption: Electronic Signature Contracts

narrationText: Drafting a new digital agreement is fast, ensuring compliance and crystal-clear terms of sale for gown purchases.
caption: Draft New Contract

narrationText: The Alterations module tracks fitting tickets, seamstress work queues, due dates, and gown pickup sign-offs.
caption: Alterations & Fitting Tickets

narrationText: Scheduling a new fitting captures hem, bustle, and bodice adjustment requirements directly into the seamstress production queue.
caption: Schedule New Fitting

narrationText: Point of Sale & Invoices processes gown deposits, split-tender payments, and final balance collections.
caption: Point of Sale & Invoices

narrationText: The central invoice table provides a complete audit trail of pending balances and fully settled accounts.
caption: Audit Pending Balances

narrationText: Generating a new invoice translates a final gown selection into a legally binding financial record.
caption: Create New Invoice

narrationText: Purchase Orders tracks designer orders, vendor portal credentials, and factory delivery lead times.
caption: Purchase Orders & Vendor Vault

narrationText: The Vendor Credentials Vault securely stores website URLs, usernames, and passwords for streamlined external ordering.
caption: Access Vendor Vault

narrationText: Issuing a new purchase order synchronizes store demand with factory production timelines effectively.
caption: Issue New Purchase Order

narrationText: The Growth & Marketing Command Center connects Meta, Google, and TikTok ad accounts, providing automated ROAS tracking and AI-driven insights.
caption: Growth Command Center

narrationText: Insights & Reports deliver executive-grade business intelligence across multiple dimensions of store performance.
caption: Store Performance Reports

narrationText: Sales by Date Range analysis enables strategic evaluation of seasonal trends and promotional efficacy.
caption: Evaluate Seasonal Trends

narrationText: Sales Goals tracking translates top-line revenue into actionable individual consultant performance quotas.
caption: Monitor Staff Quotas

narrationText: Our AI Copilot rapidly cross-references millions of data points to generate actionable insights in seconds.
caption: Run AI Trend Analysis

narrationText: Financial Ledgers provide a granular, compliant breakdown of all debits, credits, and deposits across the business.
caption: Financial Ledgers

narrationText: Switching between accounts payable, accounts receivable, and localized deposits is instantaneous via the ledger tabs.
caption: Navigate Ledger Tabs

narrationText: Staff & Roles manages employee directories, access controls, role assignments, and granular per-user permissions.
caption: Staff & Access Control

narrationText: Inviting new team members automatically handles provisioning and sets precise security access boundaries.
caption: Onboard New Staff

narrationText: Payroll features a complete workforce management suite covering timecards, exceptions, and direct deposit batching.
caption: Payroll & Workforce Command

narrationText: The tabular interface segments the payroll workflow into logical steps, preventing errors during batch processing.
caption: Navigate Payroll Workflow

narrationText: Top-level summary cards provide instant visibility into estimated gross payroll and pending exception flags.
caption: Review Payroll Summaries

narrationText: Executing a batch run securely calculates wages, applies tax withholdings, and preps the final banking file for submission.
caption: Execute Multi-Store Payroll

narrationText: Corporate Settings centralize boutique operations, booking rules, communication templates, and security audits.
caption: Corporate Settings & Config

narrationText: The configuration tabs separate operational areas, ensuring complex system rules remain easily accessible and manageable.
caption: Navigate Configuration Panels
